name: Doki Doki After School
source:
Half a decade on.

Five years after the end of the Literature Club. A chance meeting with an old friend ignites a desire to reunite the club; a chance for friends to bond with each other once more. However, each of them must deal with the harsh realities of adult life and the nostalgic allure of simpler times.

[From the [url=https://wretchedteam.com/projects/after-school/]official website[/url]]
translation:
五年过去了。

文学社结束五年后。一次与老朋友的偶遇点燃了俱乐部重新团结的愿望；朋友之间再次建立联系的机会。然而，他们每个人都必须应对成人生活的严酷现实和简单时代的怀旧诱惑。

[摘自[url=https://wretchedteam.com/projects/after-school/]官方网站[/url]]
